title: StoryTeller story
description: Everything the renderer needs: a sourced graph of nodes and edges, plus guided 'stories' (ordered paths through it). Positions are NOT authored: the renderer lays the graph out. scripts/validate.mjs enforces the rules JSON Schema cannot (referential integrity, provenance).

title.description: Short name of the subject. Becomes the wordmark unless theme.wordmark.text overrides it.

kind.description: person | company | brand | relationship | word | event | place | idea | other

tagline.description: One sentence under the wordmark: what this map shows and why it is interesting.

root.description: Node id of the centre of the map (usually the subject itself).

credit.description: Who made this, e.g. 'An independent StoryTeller study by <name>.'

disclaimer.description: Provenance/affiliation line, e.g. 'Built from X's public work. Not affiliated with X.'

clusters.description: Thematic groups (4-9 is ideal). Each gets a colour from the theme and a filter chip.

title.description: Label on the canvas. <= 30 chars reads best.

type.description: Free-form kind, shown in the panel: concept, capability, case-study, person, place, word, event, outcome...

summary.description: 1-2 sentences. What this is and why it matters to the story.

evidence.description: Optional verbatim/near-verbatim fact, figure or short quote that backs the node, exactly as the source states it.

when.description: Optional human-readable date or period shown to the reader, e.g. '2 September 1666, about 1am' or 'c. 1200 CE'.

start.description: Optional machine-readable start for the Timeline view: '1666-09-02', '1666-09', '1666', or negative for BCE ('-0500'). Date only. Keep 'when' for the human wording.

end.description: Optional end of a period (draws a bar on the timeline). Same formats as 'start'.

featured.description: Draw larger. Use for at most ~15% of nodes.

kind.description: explicit = a cited source states or directly shows it. inferred = your editorial bridge; the UI draws it dashed.

views.description: Optional. Which views to offer, in order. Default: all that apply. Timeline needs 5+ nodes with 'start'; Read needs 1+ stories.

defaultView.description: Optional. View shown on load. Default: graph.

stories.description: Guided paths. The renderer lets the reader step through them. 3-6 is ideal; each should argue something.
